scripts.dev: rm -rf node_modules/.cache packages/*/node_modules/.cache; lsof -ti :3888 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null || true; bun run --filter @briar/shared build && concurrently -k -n shared,display,node -c gray,cyan,magenta --hide shared "bun run --filter @briar/shared dev" "bun run --filter @briar/display dev" "bun run --filter @briar/node dev"
scripts.dev:node: rm -rf node_modules/.cache packages/*/node_modules/.cache; lsof -ti :3888 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null || true; bun run --filter @briar/shared build && concurrently -k -n shared,node -c gray,magenta --hide shared "bun run --filter @briar/shared dev" "bun run --filter @briar/node dev"
scripts.build: bun run --filter @briar/shared build && bun run --filter @briar/display build
scripts.dev:meeting: bun run --filter @briar/meeting-sdk build && bun run --filter @briar/meeting-app dev
scripts.build:meeting: bun run --filter @briar/meeting-sdk build && bun run --filter @briar/meeting-app build
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter @briar/shared typecheck && bun run --filter @briar/node typecheck && bun run --filter @briar/display typecheck && bun run --filter @briar/meeting-sdk typecheck && bun run --filter @briar/meeting-app typecheck
